description: A CR that is not followed by LF is rejected inside a heredoc
notes: The spec defines the newline sequences as LF and CR LF, so a lone CR should be literal heredoc text and the value "x\ry\n". In the reference scanner, heredoc text excludes CR and LF (StringLiteralChars in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl) and may only be followed by an optional CR and an LF, so nothing matches the lone CR and scanTokens turns the rest of the file into a TokenInvalid.
